title: Automating Thematic Analysis: How LLMs Analyse Controversial Topics

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the frequency and correlation of qualitative thematic assignments (e.g., 'Denial of Personal Responsibility', 'Mistrust and Skepticism') made by human researchers versus various LLMs on a dataset of subjective statements to identify differences in latent versus explicit text interpretation.

Evaluating how LLMs categorize excerpts from media coverage and government transcripts regarding a highly controversial and politicized public policy event (the Australian Robodebt scandal), specifically examining how models handle divergent political perspectives and excuse-making.
